@name: Arachnamancer
@slug: arachnamancer
@source: essence_companion
@category: RMFRP Essence Companion
@default_cost: 45
@description:
 [Lifestyle] The arachnamancer is an unusual essence user who has developed a
 great affinity for spiders. By studying the lifestyle and manners of many
 different types of spiders, the arachnamancer has developed a unique list
 that allows him to mimic many of the powers of the spider. It is theorized
 that intensive study of other animal groups could yield similar results,
 though no such research has ever been completed or developed to the extent of
 the arachnamancer. Quote: The Emperor becomes more entrapped in our web with
 each passing day. Soon he shall feel his sting. Time to Acquire: 164 months.
 Starting Money: Normal.
